messages:
Sam Nguyen: Heads-up — change window is in 2h. Freeze goes into effect at T-60m. Can everyone confirm release notes pushed and pins set?
Maya Patel: On it. Release notes are live in the repo, link: https://git.redwood/release/2026-03-20
Maya Patel: Question — what's our rollback threshold for tail latency & error rate? Need numbers for the runbook.
Devon Li: Rollback if 99th p90 latency +25% or 5% spike in 5xxs sustained for 3m. Also auto-roll for API error > 7%.
Olivia Park: Release notes summary: model v2.3.1, runtime runtime-4.6, KB cache disabled for canary. Breaking changes: name lookup has new header, clients must send X-RW-Model.
Sam Nguyen: @Devon can you confirm pin for runtime and model? Also pin any third-party deps used in the new image.
Devon Li: Pinned: model=v2.3.1, runtime=4.6-p20, quant-profile=fp16-8bit. Command used: ```/deploy pin --model v2.3.1 --runtime 4.6-p20``` 
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for service=generator, env=prod-canary at 1861236220. Canary=5% traffic for 10m then evaluate.
deploy-bot: Pinned image digest sha256:abc123... and locked routing policy to canary-only until manual promote.
Maya Patel: Who's on rollback on-call if canary fails? @Olivia to lead, @Devon backup.
Olivia Park: I can lead. Runbook checklist I printed below:
```
1) Watch canary metrics panel (latency, 5xx, token cost)
2) If thresholds breached -> /deploy rollback --to previous
3) Notify #incidents and start postmortem template
4) If rollback command fails escalate to infra oncall
```
Sam Nguyen: Quick sanity checks before freeze: docs link updated, changelog updated, notif to customers queued, smoke tests passed on staging.
Maya Patel: Smoke tests: passed 12/12, minor warning on embed-service but irrelevant to generator path.
Devon Li: We've set a temporary fallback: if canary crosses CPU>85% we'll route to fallback-model v2.2.8 automatically.
Olivia Park: Customer notice scheduled for 15m before freeze. Draft: "Planned performance rollout — possible brief latency increases". @Sam please approve.
Sam Nguyen: Approved. Send it.
Maya Patel: final go/no-go? React with :thumbsup: to go, :thumbsdown: to hold.
Devon Li: :thumbsup:
Olivia Park: :thumbsup:
Sam Nguyen: :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: All votes in. Proceeding with freeze at T-60m and canary at scheduled time. I will post status updates here during rollout.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 1861236220. Traffic=5%.
deploy-bot: Canary health check: latency nominal, errors 0.5%, cost delta +2% — monitoring.
Sam Nguyen: Thanks team. If anything odd tag this thread and call oncall.
